result: {"stdout":"# The answer pipeline — one vertical slice (contract, 2026-10-05)

Status: **contract for a build in progress.** It narrows `docs/NEXT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and the 2026-10-05 triad design
(ethos · logos · pathos; workflow wf_7d4ee812-b50) to the smallest slice that gives a person *an answer to their question, with a
citation, whose reasoning visibly tried to falsify itself*. Every shape below is binding for the parallel builders; a change needs the
integrator's say-so.

## What the user asked for (verbatim, the acceptance reading)

* "I need just an answer to my question with a citation, with the reasoning actually following good reasoning."
* "We are too much trying to only answer by snippage." — a wall of passage blocks is NOT an answer.
* "The search ITSELF must falsify its answers." — retrieval is not only support-gathering: after a candidate answer exists the fold
  searches for what would refute it ("what could I find that, if true, would make me doubt what I had said?").
* "I want to see what the model is thinking … it appears the user is asking a factual question / I can't trust my memory, let me
  research it / it says King Charles, but let me falsify it / what could I find that would make me doubt it." — a first-person,
  app-authored, step-by-step trace, shown behind a disclosure, **stacking the void recursively** (a void for the ask; sub-voids for what
  filling it needs; a void for "is it still true / is there a rival").
* "Read things, detect language, parse the grammar, put into EOT, reason over it, back to grammar, then NL."
* Popper: a claim stands only as *"survived these named attempts to refute it"*, never "true".
* Product rules still hold: the model is never alone; find/snip/cite never rewrite; omnilingual with NO case logic; a gap is drawn,
  not said; edit by subtraction.

## The slice: SLOT ASKS

A **slot ask** is a factual question whose answer is one filler of a typed slot: *who* (person) · *when/what year* (time) ·
*how many* (quantity) · *where* (place) · *what is the capital/author/…* (thing). The slice covers slot asks only. Every other ask keeps
today's path (facing/snips, existing gate) untouched.

For a slot ask the **model is not called at all** (it is the piece that hallucinated; the answer is read, reasoned over and realised
mechanically). The existing two answer modes stay for everything else.

```
ask ─► language ─► frame/void ─► read ─► bind (T1 rows) ─► candidate filler ─► FALSIFY (search for the refutation) ─► reason ─► realise ─► card
```

| parse the grammar of the ASK | `fold-chat-frame.js` (EXISTS with `stripFrame` — **extend, never clobber**) | `askFrame(question, { fw, lang, resolveTitles }) → Frame` |

| EOT / the void stack | `fold-chat-void.js` (new) | `openVoid(frame) → Void`, `fill(void, event)`, `traceOf(void) → TraceLine[]` — the void stack IS the turn's event record (append-only `events[]`; state is a projection). |
| reason: falsify | `fold-chat-falsify.js` (new) | `probesFor(candidate, frame, now) → Probe[]`, `judge(candidate, probeResults) → {standing, refuters[]}` |
| reason: choose / contest | `fold-chat-witness.js` | `reasonOver(rows, falsification) → { answer \| contest \| gap }` |
| back to grammar → NL | `fold-chat-answercard.js` (new) | `answerCardModel(turn) … [8795 more chars at the transcript address]

All 163 tests pass across the seven requested files (32 of them new, in fold-chat-answerturn.test.mjs).

What it does, stage by stage:
- **Handoff:** askFrame runs first. A non-slot ask, or a frame gap of no_grammar_for_language, frame_unread or referents_unresolved, returns `{handoff:{kind,why}}` with plain-words why text. Any unexpected exception also becomes a handoff (kind pipeline_error). Es, zh and fr asks give no_grammar_for_language and make no calls at all.
- **Binding:** every sentence of every passage is bound into rows. A sentence that does not bind on its own words gets a second try with the page title carrying the unsaid referent (needed for A4). A title-carried row only counts if its filler resolves by title. In person, place and thing asks every filler must resolve to a page (one resolveTitles call). "appointed by the monarch" therefore never becomes a candidate or a rival. If that call fails, direct rows still ship with the gap said as unmeasured, and title-carried rows are dropped.
- **Widening:** with no filled T1 row, one deps.searchPassages(frame) step runs and is recorded as a 'widen' event and a trace line. Still nothing gives gap unwitnessed with the closest row. If nothing was read at all, the gap is unreached.
- **Current-ness:** a present-tense ask drops past-tense rows. If only past rows remain, the gap is no_present_holder with that row as closest.
- **Choice:** candidates are ranked by referents covered, predicate words held, title agreement with the source page, then position.
- **Falsify:** runFalsify runs on the best candidate. A refuted candidate is set aside (its rows leave the pool) and the next is tried. A candidate contested by another candidate's row has that rival put to its own life-dates search. If the rival falls, the first is judged again with no repeat lookup, so a stale page does not turn "Charles III is the king" into a contest. At most 3 names are tried in all.
- **Outcomes:** refuted with nothing left gives gap refuted, the refuting passage as closest and the refuted claim in gap.claim. Contested gives contest rows with both kept. Survived or unmeasured gives an answer.
- **Realise:** the answer line is built from the row's own words, never a paraphrase. For copular slots it is the sentence prefix up to the last matched word before the first clause boundary ("Charles III is the king of the United Kingdom."). For a quantity with a clause word before the number it is subject plus closed-class words plus the number plus the noun ("Spiders have eight legs."). Time, or anything that cannot be built, is the row's sentence verbatim. The verbatim row and source are always attached, and answer.by is 'mechanical'.
- **Trace:** the trace and void tree come from the void stack. An aborted signal returns a partial turn with aborted:true and no answer.

Status: **contract for a build in progress.** It narrows `docs/NEXT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and the 2026-10-05 triad design
(ethos · logos · pathos; workflow wf_7d4ee812-b50) to the smallest slice that gives a person *an answer to their question, with a
citation, whose reasoning visibly tried to falsify itself*. Every shape below is binding for the parallel builders; a change needs the
integrator's say-so.

## What the user asked for (verbatim, the acceptance reading)

* "I need just an answer to my question with a citation, with the reasoning actually following good reasoning."
* "We are too much trying to only answer by snippage." — a wall of passage blocks is NOT an answer.
* "The search ITSELF must falsify its answers." — retrieval is not only support-gathering: after a candidate answer exists the fold
  searches for what would refute it ("what could I find that, if true, would make me doubt what I had said?").
* "I want to see what the model is thinking … it appears the user is asking a factual question / I can't trust my memory, let me
  research it / it says King Charles, but let me falsify it / what could I find that would make me doubt it." — a first-person,
  app-authored, step-by-step trace, shown behind a disclosure, **stacking the void recursively** (a void for the ask; sub-voids for what
  filling it needs; a void for "is it still true / is there a rival").
* "Read things, detect language, parse the grammar, put into EOT, reason over it, back to grammar, then NL."
* Popper: a claim stands only as *"survived these named attempts to refute it"*, never "true".
* Product rules still hold: the model is never alone; find/snip/cite never rewrite; omnilingual with NO case logic; a gap is drawn,
  not said; edit by subtraction.

## The slice: SLOT ASKS

A **slot ask** is a factual question whose answer is one filler of a typed slot: *who* (person) · *when/what year* (time) ·
*how many* (quantity) · *where* (place) · *what is the capital/author/…* (thing). The slice covers slot asks only. Every other ask keeps
today's path (facing/snips, existing gate) untouched.

For a slot ask the **model is not called at all** (it is the piece that hallucinated; the answer is read, reasoned over and realised
mechanically). The existing two answer modes stay for everything else.

```
ask ─► language ─► frame/void ─► read ─► bind (T1 rows) ─► candidate filler ─► FALSIFY (search for the refutation) ─► reason ─► realise ─► card

 *  from the row's own words — realise() — so a word the sentence lacks is a word nobody sourced). Words are compared case- and
 *  diacritic-folded; no case is ever read. */
function answerTurnBacksContent(msg) {
  const a = msg.answerTurn && msg.answerTurn.answer;
  const row = a && a.row;
  if (!a || !row || typeof row.sentence !== "string" || !row.sentence.trim() || !row.source || !(row.source.url || row.source.title)) return false;

  const held = new Set(words(row.sentence));
  return words(msg.content).every((w) => held.has(w));
}

'''

open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF

No. Claude Sonnet 5.5 wrote it, not a small model. The chat record for "Build a single-file HTML tip calculator…" (created about 20 minutes ago in the pane on :8814, not by me) says this:

- **Why it left the machine:** the agent record has the event `escalate · why: page · "this is a web page, and the code writer on this computer only writes functions"`. The local writer (qwen2.5-coder 1.5B) can only write JS functions, so it stepped aside.
- **Who wrote the page:** round 1 shows `try · model: claude-sonnet-5-5`, then `claude-sonnet-5-5 · sealed-external`, lane `sealed-remote`. It took 17.8 s and produced 5,965 characters of HTML.
- **The follow-up edit** ("add a 25% button, make 20% the default") was the same: Sonnet 5.5 again, 25 s, 6,156 characters. It was sent the whole current page and asked to reply with the whole updated file.
- **Why the chat says gemma2:2b:** that is just the chat's selected model. The code lane ignored it.

So this is the stopgap you called out earlier, a frontier model writing the whole page. It's the opposite of the weave design (find, snip and stitch existing code, with a model only filling small gaps). Both calls went through the sealed-external gate and were audited, so nothing was sent outside that gate.

The model-off assembler in `experiments/specimen-assembly` already builds tip-calculator pages without a model (see `PAGES.md`). Making it the first rung and escalating only on failure would match your rule. I haven't touched it. Want me to wire that in?

result: {"stdout":"# The answer pipeline — one vertical slice (contract, 2026-10-05)

Status: **contract for a build in progress.** It narrows `docs/NEXT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and the 2026-10-05 triad design
(ethos · logos · pathos; workflow wf_7d4ee812-b50) to the smallest slice that gives a person *an answer to their question, with a
citation, whose reasoning visibly tried to falsify itself*. Every shape below is binding for the parallel builders; a change needs the
integrator's say-so.

## What the user asked for (verbatim, the acceptance reading)

* "I need just an answer to my question with a citation, with the reasoning actually following good reasoning."
* "We are too much trying to only answer by snippage." — a wall of passage blocks is NOT an answer.
* "The search ITSELF must falsify its answers." — retrieval is not only support-gathering: after a candidate answer exists the fold
  searches for what would refute it ("what could I find that, if true, would make me doubt what I had said?").

  app-authored, step-by-step trace, shown behind a disclosure, **stacking the void recursively** (a void for the ask; sub-voids for what
  filling it needs; a void for "is it still true / is there a rival").

* Popper: a claim stands only as *"survived these named attempts to refute it"*, never "true".
* Product rules still hold: the model is never alone; find/snip/cite never rewrite; omnilingual with NO case logic; a gap is drawn,
  not said; edit by subtraction.

A **slot ask** is a factual question whose answer is one filler of a typed slot: *who* (person) · *when/what year* (time) ·
*how many* (quantity) · *where* (place) · *what is the capital/author/…* (thing). The slice covers slot asks only. Every other ask keeps
today's path (facing/snips, existing gate) untouched.

For a slot ask the **model is not called at all** (it is the piece that hallucinated; the answer is read, reasoned over and realised
mechanically). The existing two answer modes stay for everything else.

```
ask ─► language ─► frame/void ─► read ─► bind (T1 rows) ─► candidate filler ─► FALSIFY (search for the refutation) ─► reason ─► realise ─► card

recorded so a SURPRISE (a case that goes the other way) is visible as one. Nothing here is changed after the run; a case that
cannot be made to run is reported `unmeasured`, never `pass` (Constitution II.10).

## Stance
We never learn that the fold is right; we learn which conjectures have so far survived a serious attempt to refute them. So every
claim the fold makes about its own behaviour is written as a universal that ONE counterexample refutes, and every case is built to
produce that counterexample if the claim is false. A confirming case is only evidence when it could have gone the other way
(II.10): each refuting case is paired with a CONTROL the same gate must let through, because a gate that suppresses everything
"survives" every refutation test and is useless (the false-positive side of the same law).

The same stance applies to what the fold SHOWS: a sentence's standing is "has survived the checks that were run on it" and the checks
are named — never "true". (The design workflow's plan must say what a sentence survived.)

Offline, deterministic, no real model. The REAL page (Playwright, headless, fresh context per case, the working tree as served on

result: {"stdout":"# The answer pipeline — one vertical slice (contract, 2026-10-05)

Status: **contract for a build in progress.** It narrows `docs/NEXT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and the 2026-10-05 triad design
(ethos · logos · pathos; workflow wf_7d4ee812-b50) to the smallest slice that gives a person *an answer to their question, with a
citation, whose reasoning visibly tried to falsify itself*. Every shape below is binding for the parallel builders; a change needs the
integrator's say-so.

## What the user asked for (verbatim, the acceptance reading)

* "I need just an answer to my question with a citation, with the reasoning actually following good reasoning."
* "We are too much trying to only answer by snippage." — a wall of passage blocks is NOT an answer.
* "The search ITSELF must falsify its answers." — retrieval is not only support-gathering: after a candidate answer exists the fold
  searches for what would refute it ("what could I find that, if true, would make me doubt what I had said?").
* "I want to see what the model is thinking … it appears the user is asking a factual question / I can't trust my memory, let me
  research it / it says King Charles, but let me falsify it / what could I find that would make me doubt it." — a first-person,
  app-authored, step-by-step trace, shown behind a disclosure, **stacking the void recursively** (a void for the ask; sub-voids for what
  filling it needs; a void for "is it still true / is there a rival").
* "Read things, detect language, parse the grammar, put into EOT, reason over it, back to grammar, then NL."
* Popper: a claim stands only as *"survived these named attempts to refute it"*, never "true".
* Product rules still hold: the model is never alone; find/snip/cite never rewrite; omnilingual with NO case logic; a gap is drawn,
  not said; edit by subtraction.

## The slice: SLOT ASKS

A **slot ask** is a factual question whose answer is one filler of a typed slot: *who* (person) · *when/what year* (time) ·
*how many* (quantity) · *where* (place) · *what is the capital/author/…* (thing). The slice covers slot asks only. Every other ask keeps
today's path (facing/snips, existing gate) untouched.

For a slot ask the **model is not called at all** (it is the piece that hallucinated; the answer is read, reasoned over and realised
mechanically). The existing two answer modes stay for everything else.

```
ask ─► language ─► frame/void ─► read ─► bind (T1 rows) ─► candidate filler ─► FALSIFY (search for the refutation) ─► reason ─► realise ─► card
```

| parse the grammar of the ASK | `fold-chat-frame.js` (EXISTS with `stripFrame` — **extend, never clobber**) | `askFrame(question, { fw, lang, resolveTitles }) → Frame` |
| parse the grammar of the PASSAGE | `fold-chat-witness.js` (new) | `sentencesOf(text) → [{text, start, end}]`, `bindSentence(sentence, frame, { fw }) → Row \| null` |
| EOT / the void stack | `fold-chat-void.js` (new) | `openVoid(frame) → Void`, `fill(void, event)`, `traceOf(void) → TraceLine[]` — the void stack IS the turn's event record (append-only `events[]`; state is a projection). |
| reason: falsify | `fold-chat-falsify.js` (new) | `probesFor(candidate, frame, now) → Probe[]`, `judge(candidate, probeResults) → {standing, refuters[]}` |
| reason: choose / contest | `fold-chat-witness.js` | `reasonOver(rows, falsification) → { answer \| contest \| gap }` |

Any unexpected exception also becomes a handoff (kind pipeline_error). Es, zh and fr asks give no_grammar_for_language and make no calls at all.
- **Binding:** every sentence of every passage is bound into rows. A sentence that does not bind on its own words gets a second try with the page title carrying the unsaid referent (needed for A4). A title-carried row only counts if its filler resolves by title. In person, place and thing asks every filler must resolve to a page (one resolveTitles call). "appointed by the monarch" therefore never becomes a candidate or a rival. If that call fails, direct rows still ship with the gap said as unmeasured, and title-carried rows are dropped.
